programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: As Jane tries to avoid aggravating Owen's heart condition, Deb's mother Bobbie Dobkins is being sued for an injury sustained by her dance student, Kiera Walsh. As she's meeting with Kiera's mom Megan, Jane is unhappy to learn that Bobbie's insurance company has assigned the pushy and annoying lawyer Simon Grundy to represent its interests. Meanwhile, Grayson's high school classmate Fiona Krupp hires him when the city of Lakewood refuses to pay her for a sculpture it commissioned and now claims is obscene. And when Luke seeks her advice about buying concert tickets for a date, Stacy assumes they are for her. Once Kiera testifies that Bobbie made her do a dance move that resulted in what Megan says is a career-ending injury, both Jane and Simon ask Bobbie to consider settling. While Jane gets Megan to consider payment for Kiera's medical costs, Simon insists that she also withdraw the claim for loss of future earnings. So when Bobbie makes matters worse by saying that Kiera would have never made it as a professional dancer, Megan angrily refuses any offer. And when she vindictively amends the lawsuit to include emotional distress, Bobbie looks to strengthen her legal team by firing Jane and hiring Parker. Meanwhile, Grayson proves that Lakewood officials approved Fiona's sketches, and Judge Owen French orders the city to pay her for the finished piece. Although Megan settles with the insurance company for Kiera's medical bills, Bobbie still remains liable for the emotional damage claim. But when Jane finds that Kiera was actually injured while skateboarding before her dance lesson, not only does the jury decide in Bobbie's favor, but the insurance company fires Simon. When Teri organizes a demonstration in support of Fiona's artwork, Owen is inspired to rule that it cannot be altered by the city. And after Fiona admits that she always intended her sculpture to be provocative in order to gain notoriety for her work, she and Grayson start a romantic relationship.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva
programme.desc: With the support of Councilman Mark Phillips, Jane files a lawsuit on behalf of Jenny Evans, a teenager who collapsed at a rave put on by promoter Dennis Fullman. After she receives a death threat against Owen meant to dissuade her from pursuing the case, Jane opts not to tell him for fear of aggravating his heart condition. However, once Owen learns that he's under police protection and insists Jane continue with the suit, things get tougher when Jenny's friend Carla admits that they took ecstasy before the rave. Meanwhile, when Owen hesitates to invite his father to their wedding, Jane asks Stacy to investigate. After donating his sperm to Carrie Renner, Dan Abraham hires Kim and Grayson when Carrie and her new fiancé Rick Keller insist that he relinquish his parental rights. Though Keller has Dan arrested for illegally trafficking in human tissue, the case is dropped after Kim demands that anyone who engaged in a privately arranged sperm donation also be prosecuted. And when Keller accuses Dan of violating a state law that prohibits gay men from being sperm donors, Kim's contention that the government has no business dictating how people choose to get pregnant prompts Carrie to leave her bullying fiancé and negotiate visitation rights for Dan. When Jenny dies, both her mother and Carla insist that Jane pursue her case. After an autopsy shows that Jenny died from dehydration and not a drug overdose, Jane and Owen discover that the water fountains in the Coliseum were turned off, leaving the 30,000 attendees to buy bottled water from a company owned by none other than Councilman Phillips. And once Jane finds proof that he's behind the threat against Owen, Phillips is arrested for Jenny's death. Finally, Owen admits that his reluctance over the invitation stems from his disapproval of his father's recent wedding. But as Owen reconciles with his dad, Jane resists telling him the truth about her identity.

And when the company agrees to settle, Brand credits Jane for salvaging the case before announcing that he is retiring. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Several people travel by bus to the Sunwest Dude Ranch, and when they arrive one of them is dead. The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to \avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. programme.title: Charlie's Angels

First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. programme.desc: Charlie's Angels must carry out an unusual assignment: three men have stolen a sack of rubies, and when one of them, Murdoch, double-crosses his two partners by escaping with the rubies, the other two hire the Angels to recover the missing jewels. The Angels are not "hired" exactly; Sabrina is forced to put on a belt loaded with explosives, and if the rubies are not recovered within twelve hours, the belt will set off by remote control. The designer of this belt is the one who masterminded the jewel theft, a psychotic electronics wizard named Dinsmore. From the crazy look in his eye, the Angels decide they better do as he says, so Kris and Kelly go out looking for Murdoch. Since Dinsmore shot him in the back as he was running away, they check the hospital first , but after the bullet was removed, Murdoch left in a hurry in order to sell the rubies. Charlie locates two men who helped the crooks steal the gems and who may be of use, if they can be forced to talk. Kris and Kelly leave these two locked in a bathroom naked after getting the information they need, and continue their search. By some excellent acting over the phone, Sabrina makes Dinsmore think that Kris has run off with Murdoch and the rubies, so he and Sabrina head for the airport to stop them. It is part of an elaborate plan to separate Dinsmore from the belt-exploding device, and it calls for Sabrina to dive into a puddle of muddy water where the radio signal won't reach the belt. At least she hopes it doesn't! Sabrina pretends to 'faint' upon seeing the snake, and Kelly makes a wax impression of the lock to the only window in the room. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels have never played football before, but that changes quickly when Amy Jarvis and her father Dan come to them for help. The Jarvis' football team, all women, has a big game scheduled against Julia Smyth's Panthers, but a pair of motorcycle riders has been terrorizing Amy and warning her not to play. Joining the team is only a cover, but Sabrina displays such good form that Julia Smyth invites her to play for the Panthers. Julia's only concern is winning, and her players are rough and well trained. More interestingly to Sabrina, Julia rides a motorcycle. But whether or not the Angels solve the mystery, Sabrina is so disgusted by Julia's "win-at-any-cost" attitude that she is determined to help Amy's team defeat the Panthers. Kelly meets a sad person named Joe Phillips in the parking lot, and they go out for dinner. Joe is a former football star whose injured knee forced him to retire, and now he feels like only half a man. Joe does not seem involved with the recent trouble, and Kelly grows tired of hearing how sad his life is. By locating all the local dealers who sell a certain kind of motorcycle, the Angels find the two that were used to scare the players, and driving away in a truck is none other than Joe Phillips. Furthermore he has taken blueprints of the stadium with him, as though he needed to know how to gain entry into rooms that would be locked, like the room where the stadium's safe is kept. Down on the field, Sabrina realizes that one of her teammates is Julia's spy and is secretly telling the Panthers what plays to expect. Using this knowledge, Sabrina outsmarts the cheaters, by calling one play and then running a different one. Catching crooks is the Angels' job, but winning this game is very satisfying. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When two blonde "call girls" are brutally murdered in Mrs. Dolly Smith's apartment building, Kelly and Kris reluctantly go undercover as prostitutes and move into Mrs. Smith's establishment. On their first day at work, the trio arouses suspicion with their clever tactics to avoid meeting with "customers." But the Angels are more interested in the Italian restaurant across the street, where Freddie, the macho delivery boy works. He brings pizza to the girls in the building almost every day, and always acts aggressive and threatening. Then Bonnie, another blond girl, is attacked but manages to escape. When she says her assailant smelled like a restaurant, it looks like Freddie is the man. Freddie swears he's innocent, and when his shark's tooth pendant is found beside the latest victim, Sabrina wonders if it isn't a bit too obvious a clue. The owner of the Italian restaurant, Roman Vail, also has access to the apartment building, and the. Angels are surprised to learn that he knows Freddie lost his pendant. Also the last victim died with bits of skin under her fingernails, and Vail's arms show many scratch marks. When Sabrina and Kelly finally put the evidence together, they must rush to rescue blond-haired Kris who is alone in the restaurant with Vail. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels must carry out an unusual assignment: three men have stolen a sack of rubies, and when one of them, Murdoch, double-crosses his two partners by escaping with the rubies, the other two hire the Angels to recover the missing jewels. The Angels are not "hired" exactly; Sabrina is forced to put on a belt loaded with explosives, and if the rubies are not recovered within twelve hours, the belt will set off by remote control. The designer of this belt is the one who masterminded the jewel theft, a psychotic electronics wizard named Dinsmore. From the crazy look in his eye, the Angels decide they better do as he says, so Kris and Kelly go out looking for Murdoch. Since Dinsmore shot him in the back as he was running away, they check the hospital first , but after the bullet was removed, Murdoch left in a hurry in order to sell the rubies. Charlie locates two men who helped the crooks steal the gems and who may be of use, if they can be forced to talk. Kris and Kelly leave these two locked in a bathroom naked after getting the information they need, and continue their search. By some excellent acting over the phone, Sabrina makes Dinsmore think that Kris has run off with Murdoch and the rubies, so he and Sabrina head for the airport to stop them. It is part of an elaborate plan to separate Dinsmore from the belt-exploding device, and it calls for Sabrina to dive into a puddle of muddy water where the radio signal won't reach the belt. At least she hopes it doesn't! Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Freddie the Fox" Brander is retired, but thirty years ago he was the world's greatest thief. Still dignified and charming as in days of old, he is disturbed in his retirement by two former crime partners who are sure that Freddie has the famous "Light of Arabia" diamond. They are preparing to torture him into revealing where it is, but Freddie escapes and goes straight to Charlie's Angels for help. He knows that the diamond is in the possession of oil sheik Faris Salim, who keeps it in his extremely well-guarded Caribbean estate. Freddie's plan is for the Angels to assist him in stealing the diamond once again, so that he can return it to the museum, and retire from crime forever. The Angels eagerly accept the job, and assume new identities for the Caribbean caper. Freddie and Sabrina become Lord and Lady Brander, with Bosley as their butler and Kelly as their private secretary. Kris pretends to be a racing car enthusiast in order to win the attention of Ali, Salim's mechanic-minded son. The idea is for everyone to get invited to Salim's birthday party, and once in the house, learn where the diamond is kept so Freddie can decide how to steal it. Since Salim has an affinity for nobility, invitations are not difficult to obtain. At the party, while Sabrina snaps pictures from a secret camera planted in her jeweled pin, Salim decides to show off his prize diamond, which is, indeed, guarded securely. the entire floor is electrified, ands as deadly snake hovers over the jewel. Sabrina pretends to 'faint' upon seeing the snake, and Kelly makes a wax impression of the lock to the only window in the room. This, with the secret photos, provides Freddie with all he needs to engineer the theft. A little help from Ali is needed at last minute -- he never did like his father very much. programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: The Angels have never played football before, but that changes quickly when Amy Jarvis and her father Dan come to them for help. The Jarvis' football team, all women, has a big game scheduled against Julia Smyth's Panthers, but a pair of motorcycle riders has been terrorizing Amy and warning her not to play. Joining the team is only a cover, but Sabrina displays such good form that Julia Smyth invites her to play for the Panthers. Julia's only concern is winning, and her players are rough and well trained. More interestingly to Sabrina, Julia rides a motorcycle. But whether or not the Angels solve the mystery, Sabrina is so disgusted by Julia's "win-at-any-cost" attitude that she is determined to help Amy's team defeat the Panthers. Kelly meets a sad person named Joe Phillips in the parking lot, and they go out for dinner. Joe is a former football star whose injured knee forced him to retire, and now he feels like only half a man. Joe does not seem involved with the recent trouble, and Kelly grows tired of hearing how sad his life is. By locating all the local dealers who sell a certain kind of motorcycle, the Angels find the two that were used to scare the players, and driving away in a truck is none other than Joe Phillips. Furthermore he has taken blueprints of the stadium with him, as though he needed to know how to gain entry into rooms that would be locked, like the room where the stadium's safe is kept. Down on the field, Sabrina realizes that one of her teammates is Julia's spy and is secretly telling the Panthers what plays to expect. Using this knowledge, Sabrina outsmarts the cheaters, by calling one play and then running a different one. Catching crooks is the Angels' job, but winning this game is very satisfying. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosle

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.desc: Heidis sociala nätverk krymper när Spencer 'gör slut' med Brody för att istället hänga med Lauren. Audrina vill göra relationen med Justin officiell, men han vägrar.

programme.title: The Hills: Second Chances
programme.desc: Lauren känner en fläkt från det förflutna när expojkvännen Jason ringer. Heidi konkurrerar med jobbarkompisen Elodie om en högre tjänst.

programme.title: The Hills: They Meet Again
programme.desc: Laurens känslor för Jason har återvänt, men när de springer på Heidi och Spencer på en restaurang väcks upprörda känslor. Heidis befordran kostar henne Elodies vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: For Better Or Worse
programme.desc: Lauren blir chockad när hon förstår att Jason har en flickvän, men Jason har en ännu större överraskning i beredskap. Heidi upptäcker att Spencer inte berättat för sina föräldrar om deras bröllopsplaner.

programme.title: The Hills: What Happens In Vegas...
programme.desc: Gänget firar Brodys födelsedag i Las Vegas. Audrinas pojkvän Justin skapar en klyfta i vänskapen mellan henne och Lauren. Attraktionen mellan Lauren och Brody växer.

programme.title: The Hills: What Goes Around
programme.desc: Jen Bunney säger till Lauren att Brody startade ryktesspridningen om henne, men Brody skyller på Spencer och lämnar Heidi i kläm mellan dem. Lauren ber Audrina om ursäkt för att hon blandat sig i relationen med Justin.

programme.title: The Hills: No More Mr. Nice Guy
programme.desc: Lauren börjar en ny romans med en manlig modell, men upptäcker att hon fortfarande har känslor för Brody. Spencer är rädd att han håller på att förlora Heidi till hennes nya jobb.

programme.title: The Hills: Stress And The City
programme.desc: Whitney och Lauren åker till New York för Teen Vogue och Spencer når fram till Brody.

programme.title: The Hills
programme.desc: Whitney och Lauren jobbar på Young Hollywood Party och Heidi firar sin 21:a födelsedag.

programme.title: The Hills: Forgive and Forget
programme.desc: Heidi och Lauren har ett nytt offentligt gräl, som får Heidi att komma tillbaka och be Lauren om ursäkt för allt som hänt. Audrinas relation med Justin går på i gamla hjulspår, men karriären på Epic Records tar fart.

programme.title: The Hills: With This Ring...
programme.desc: Lauren leker äktenskapsmäklare när Whitney går på sin första dejt med deras personlige tränare. Spencer motarbetar Heidis planer för ett sagobröllop, med ett gräl som hotar förlovningen som resultat.

programme.title: The Hills: A Night At The Opera
programme.desc: Audrina får syn på Justin när han kysser en annan tjej, vilket leder till en slutlig konfrontation om deras relation. Heidi blir chockad när Spencers syster Stephanie muckar gräl med Lauren och Brody på en nattklubb.

programme.title: The Hills: Once a Player
programme.desc: Lauren tror att Brody kanske är för mycket av en playboy, för att hon ska kunna mena allvar med honom. Spencers syster berättar för honom att Heidi i hemlighet hyser tvivel inför deras bröllop.

programme.title: The Hills: When One Door Closes...
programme.desc: Lauren får höra spännande nyheter på Teen Vogue och Heidi behöver komma bort från Spencer ett tag.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer äntligen iväg till Paris, men hennes drömresa blir nästan förstörd när hon upptäcker att Brody har hittat en ny. Spencer följer efter Heidi till Colorado, för att vinna tillbaka henne, men planen går i baklås.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney måste välja mellan tryggheten på Teen Vogue och riskerna med en ny karriär. Lauren och Brody hamnar i konflikt om hans nya flickvän och Heidi anpassar sig till ett liv utan Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en osannolik vän när Spenders syster Stephanie börjar på hennes modekurs. Whitney tycker att det nya jobbet är som en dröm, men en hektisk resa till New York får henne att minnas att man ska vara försiktig med vad man önskar sig.

programme.title: The Hills: When Spencer Finds Out...
programme.desc: När Lauren bjuder Stephanie på sin födelsedagsfest ifrågasätter Heidi och Spencer Stephanies lojalitet. Spencer sjösätter en plan för att vinna tillbaka Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Just Be Careful...

programme.title: The Hills: Girls' Night Out
programme.desc: Heidi älskar sitt singelliv ända tills hon ser Spencer med andra tjejer och blir svartsjuk. Whitney värvar Lauren för att hjälpa till på LA Fashion Week, och öppnar på så sätt nya dörrar för Lauren i hennes karriär.

programme.desc: Treåringen Ana lider av kraniosynostos som trycker ihop hennes hjärna. Kei föddes utan öron, men har blivit en begåvad musiker.

programme.title: 1000-lb Roomies: I Came, I Saw, I Needed a Break
programme.desc: Jaz kämpar med att ta sig ombord på båten till Catalina Island samtidigt som Nesha får ångest inför loppet. Tjejerna planerar sin första utlandsresa.

programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters: Not So Fast Car
programme.desc: Amy och Tammy får en dålig start på vägen mot körkortet. Chris och Brittany får oväntade nyheter, och Tammy är inte redo att förlåta Misty.

programme.title: Family By The Ton
programme.desc: Familjen Anderson väger mer än 1 350 kg fördelat på sex personer och alla dras med ett handikappande matberoende.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress: Randy Will Show You The Door
programme.desc: Brudklänningsmodellen Jessica vill att vännerna ska bestämma vilken klänning hon ska gifta sig i, men när vännerna spårar ur måste Randy ta över.

programme.title: Cake Boss: Helicopters And Hypnosis
programme.desc: Buddy och gänget blir förvirrade när ett helikopterföretag beställer en tårta och de får även ordna en munktårta med bröllopstema åt en blivande brud!

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress: A Dress To Match My Black Heart
programme.desc: Camila vill ha en svart brudklänning, men det kan bli för mycket för hennes lika temperamentsfulla mamma!

programme.title: Down Home Fab: The Speakeasy
programme.desc: Chelsea och Cole levererar design för par vars barn flyttat ut och som behöver eget utrymme för sitt nya liv, men ändå vill kunna ha familjeträffar.

programme.title: Outdaughtered: This Little Quint Stays Home
programme.desc: Danielle och Adam funderar på att låta femlingarna börja på dagis, men de blir tvungna att överväga att sära på flickorna.

programme.title: Australiens mästerkock
programme.desc: På sin sista dag i Qatar ställs kockarna inför en sista immunitetsutmaning på flygplatsen. De måste skapa en rätt som passar en business class-meny.

programme.title: Cake Boss: Påskhare, födelsedag och bränd mat
programme.desc: Beställningarna ramlar in under påsken, en av årets mest stressfyllda veckor. Graces beslut att laga en påskmiddag gör alla nervösa.

programme.title: Cake Boss: Bröllop, vatten och slutkörd!
programme.desc: En lokal affärsman ber teamet göra en tårta i form av ett roulettebord och tårtbeställningarna hopar sig när bröllopssäsongen börjar.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: The Other Way: No Shoes, No Trust, Problems
programme.desc: Jessy får ett bryskt uppvaknande på landsbygden, Andi oroar sig för att träffa Nigels andra älskare, och Jon ryker ihop med Allys bästa vän.

programme.title: Love In Paradise: The Caribbean: Rump Shaker
programme.desc: Valentine landar i Colombia, men Carlos oroar sig för hur de ska lösa sina problem innan bröllopet.

programme.title: Sister Wives: An Awkward Valentines Day
programme.desc: Alla hjärtans dag visar sig bli besvärligt för en polygamist. Mariah och hennes flickvän dyker upp på Kodys födelsedagsfest med en stor nyhet.

programme.title: Australiens mästerkock
programme.desc: Domaren Andy Allen presenterar en hemlig låda som utmanar de tävlande med ovanliga smaker som måste kombineras i en rätt.

programme.title: Australiens mästerkock
programme.desc: Deltagarna anländer till restaurangen Vue de Monde där de möter köksmästaren Hugh Allen för ännu en provsmakningsutmaning.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance: Are We Really Doing This?
programme.desc: Mallorie har ett svårt samtal med sin mamma, Marissa bryter ihop på bröllopsdagen och Ashia oroar sig över att Rod inte kommer att dyka upp.

programme.title: Baylen Out Loud: Uncensored: 'Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Sammis planerade överraskningar leder till att Baylen och Julie fattar några permanenta beslut och tillbringar en kväll på en begravningsbyrå.

programme.title: Sister Wives
programme.desc: Janelle försöker utmana sig själv och går på linedance. Meri och Christine träffas för att prata om det förflutna.

programme.title: Match Me Abroad: Playing With Fire
programme.desc: Victorias dejt leder till en överraskande upptäckt. Amber hamnar i fängelse med sin partner. Monica slits mellan två friare och väljer sin nästa dejt.

programme.title: Dr Pimple Popper: Scared Cyst-less
programme.desc: Dr Sandra Lee hjälper Taylore som är en ung kvinna med fula knölar på öronen. Jose går aldrig ut på grund av en stor knöl på huvudet.

programme.title: Body Bizarre: The Teen Who Wants A Voice
programme.desc: Rebecca kräks upp till tolv gånger i timmen och måste regelbundet läggas in på sjukhus. Jacque har en lymfatisk missbildning i ansiktet.

programme.desc: Under 2018 kommer justitieminister Tor Mikkel Wara att utsättas för flera allvarliga attacker mot sitt hem. Polisen står utan ledtrådar. Snart är dock skandalen ett faktum när polisen misstänker hans sambo.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: När 32-årige Memo plötsligt försvinner tar hans vänner saken i egna händer och börjar desperat leta efter honom. Deras oro förvandlas till ren skräck när deras sökande leder till oroande upptäckter.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 105

programme.title: I Huvudet På En Gärningsman SV: Avsnitt 203
programme.desc: En ensamvarg som bestämt sig för att mörda. Under 2018 och 2019 begår 20-åringen flera överfall mot personer på promenad i Sollentuna. Upprymd över vad han gjort ringer han till SOS för att skryta.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 1102
programme.desc: Ett antal bränder härjar i Askersund, och 18-årige Linus blir snart misstänkt. Men Linus är försvunnen, och ju längre tiden går, desto mer skrämmande blir polisens föraningar.

programme.title: Norske Krimsaker: Avsnitt 201
programme.desc: En dag i augusti ses den 20-åriga hotellarbetaren Trude Espås sitta på en klippa i närheten av staden Geiranger. 11 dagar senare hittas hon mördad. Efter 25 år är mordet fortfarande ett stort mysterium.

programme.title: Svenska fall
programme.desc: Tidigt en februarimorgon i Stockholm anmäler en man sin fru, Sacha, försvunnen. När polisen gräver i parets förflutna upptäcker de under den till synes ordnade ytan en turbulent relation.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 1103
programme.desc: I augusti 2019 hittas en man svårt blödande efter att ha knivskurits. Polisen kan inte knyta misstänkta till dådet, eller hitta ledtrådar i och med det brott offret själv utretts för.

programme.title: I Huvudet På En Gärningsman SV: Avsnitt 206

programme.desc: Quinn ja hänen isänsä ovat muuttaneet hiljaiseen Kettle Springsin kaupunkiin aloittaakseen puhtaalta pöydältä. Vastassa on kuitenkin kovia kokenut hajonnut yhteisö. Kun paikalliset kinastelevat, ja jännitteet paisuvat, pahaenteinen hahmo ilmestyy maissipelloilta puhdistamaan kaupunkia rasitteistaan yksi verinen uhri kerrallaan. Todellinen hauskanpito alkaa, kun Frendo-klovni saapuu leikkimään. Amerikkalainen kauhuelokuva vuodelta 2025.

programme.title: Deadfall
programme.desc: Sisarukset Addison (Eric Bana) ja Liza (Olivia Wilde) ovat pakomatkalla ryöstettyään Casinon. Toisaalla entinen nyrkkeilijä Jay (Charlie Hunnam) on matkalla kotiin vanhempiensa luo. Addison ja Liza pakenevat eri teitä kohti Kanadan rajaa kesken raivoisaa lumimyrskyä. Väkivaltainen Addison aiheuttaa paetessaan sekasortoa, kun Liza puolestaan liftaa Jayn kyydillä lähimpään kaupunkiin. Jayn vanhempien Junen (Sissy Spacek) ja Chetin (Kris Kristofferson) luona myrskyä paetessaan he ymmärtävät, että kohtalo on tuonut heidät yhteen. Amerikkalainen trilleri vuodelta 2012.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter Two
programme.desc: John Wick on täällä taas! Legendaarinen palkkamurhaaja on vetäytynyt kuvioista, mutta hänen on pakko hoitaa vielä yksi keikka Roomassa. Se ei kuitenkaan jää Wickin viimeiseksi, sillä yhtäkkiä koko palkkamurhaajien kilta kääntyy häntä vastaan, eikä hän voi luottaa keneenkään. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2017.

programme.title: Johnny English - uudestisyntynyt
programme.desc: Johnny English palaa ruutuihin vakoilukomediassa Johnny English - Uudestisyntynyt. English jatkaa epätodennäköisenä agenttina joka ei tunne pelkoa eikä vaaraa. Brittiläinen komedia vuodelta 2011.

programme.title: The Iron mask
programme.desc: Englantilainen matkailija Jonathan Green saa Pietari Suurelta tilauksen kartoittaa Venäjän Kaukoidän. Jälleen kerran hän valmistautuu pitkään seikkailuun, joka tällä kertaa johdattaa hänet kauas Kiinaan. Yllätyksiä täynnä olevalla seikkailullaan kartografi tekee henkeäsalpaavia löytöjä, kohtaa ennennäkemättömiä olentoja, tapaa kiinalaisia prinsessoja sekä joutuu vastakkain taistelulajien mestareiden ja lopulta jopa suuren lohikäärmekuninkaan kanssa. Venäläinen toiminta vuodelta 2019.

programme.title: Armoton maa
programme.desc: Moderni lännenelokuva entisestä pyssysankarista, joka joutuu tarttumaan jälleen aseisiin, kun korruptoitunut seriffi uhkaa häntä ja hänen karjanhoitajiaan. Amerikkalainen lännenelokuva 2003.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: Ryhmä entisiä kasarivideopelimestareita on ihmiskunnan ainoa toivo torjua avaruusolioiden hyökkäys tässä visuaalisesti näyttävässä toimintaseikkailussa. Amerikkalainen komedia vuodelta 2015.

programme.title: Tag
programme.desc: Perustuu oikeisiin tapahtumiin luokkakavereista, jotka eivät osaa lopettaa traditiotaan – he leikkivät hippaa joka vuosi. Valmiina menestymään, totta kai. Amerikkalainen komedia vuodelta 2018.

programme.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
programme.desc: Ikiaikainen ihmisten ja jättiläisten välinen sota syttyy uudelleen, kun nuori maalaispoika aukaisee vahingossa portin, joka erottaa meidän maailmamme kauhistuttavien jättien maasta. Kun jättiläiset pääsevät vuosisatojen karkotuksen jälkeen takaisin maan päälle, he yrittävät vallata sen itselleen. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2013.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: Natsien käsistä pelastettu paholainen vaihtaa puolta ja ryhtyy taistelemaan pimeyden voimia vastaan. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2004.

programme.title: Muumio: Lohikäärmekeisarin hauta
programme.desc: Jack ja Evy lähtevät kuljettamaan jalokiveä Kiinaan Englannin hallinnon laskuun. Kiinassa he huomaavat, että kenraali jahtaa samaa jalokiveä kuin he kuljettavat. Amerikkalainen toimintaseikkailu vuodelta 2008.

programme.title: Lone Survivor
programme.desc: Kesäkuu 2005. Afganistanissa toimiva amerikkalaisten erikoisjoukko, Seal Team 10, lähtee suorittamaan huippusalaista ja äärimmäisen vaarallista tehtävää: Neljä erikoisjoukkojen miestä määrätään tappamaan pahamaineinen Taliban-johtaja, Ahmad Shahdin. Tehtävä osoittautuu vielä vaarallisemmaksi kuin miehet osasivat pelätäkään... Ryöstökeikkana alkaneesta tehtävästä tulee maailmanlaajuinen jännittävä takaa-ajo, kun kaksikko yrittää saada palkkion ennen häikäilemätöntä Moncadaa (Antonio Banderas), joka uskoo olevansa perheineen laillinen perijä. Jos Nate ja Sully voivat selvittää johtolangat ja ratkaista yhden maailman vanhimmista mysteereistä, heillä on mahdollisuus löytää viiden miljardin arvoinen aarre ja ehkä jopa Naten kauan sitten kadonnut veli... mutta vain, jos he oppivat tekemään yhteistyötä. Amerikkalainen toimintaseikkailu vuodelta 2021.

Omistajan oikeudella Bart kouluttaa Dannya kuin koiraa, jotta julmasti alistettu mies voi toimia Bartin henkivartijana ja voittaa tälle omaisuuksia verisissä gladiaattoritaisteluissa. Mutta nyt Bart on poissa ja Danny jää yksin. Koulutettu tappokone ei tunne ketään muita ihmisiä, eikä osaa kommunikoida lainkaan. Sitten Danny tapaa sokean Samin, joka yrittää opettaa Dannya olemaan ihmisiksi. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2005.

programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva tarina nuorten baseball-joukkueesta, joka ylitti kaikki odotukset pääsemällä junioreiden baseballin maailmanmestaruuskisoihin. Omistettuaan kauden joukkuetoverinsa sairaalle isälle, ryhmä aliarvostettuja nuoria pääsee aina vuoden 2002 juniorien maailmanmestaruusturnaukseen asti, joka huipentuu ennätyksiä rikkoneeseen loppuotteluun, josta tuli välittömästi ESPN-klassikko. Amerikkalainen draama vuodelta 2024.

Myrskyn lähestyessä pojat irrottavat juuttunutta ankkuria, kun vene kaatuu ja he sinkoutuvat hyiseen veteen. Amerikkalainen trilleri vuodelta 2023.

programme.title: Kolme muskettisoturia: Milady

programme.title: Fackham Hall
programme.desc: Uusi portieeri muodostaa oudon siteen Davenportin perheen nuorimman tyttären kanssa. Davenportit ovat korkea-arvoinen brittiläinen suku, jota johtavat lordi ja lady Davenport. Perheen on selvitettävä tämä tilanne ja samalla myös toinen mahdollisesti katastrofaalinen ongelma: vanhimman tyttären ja hänen häikäilemättömän serkkunsa suunniteltu avioliitto. Brittiläinen komedia vuodelta 2025.

programme.title: Eleanor The Great
programme.desc: Eleanor The Great -elokuvassa June Squibb herättää elävästi eloon nokkelan ja ylpeän hankalan 94-vuotiaan Eleanor Morgensteinin, joka on kokenut järkyttävän menetyksen ja kertoo tarinan, joka alkaa elää omaa vaarallista elämäänsä. Scarlett Johanssonin ohjaajadebyytti käsittelee koomisesti ja terävästi sitä, miten kuulemistamme tarinoista tulee kertomiamme tarinoita. Draama vuodelta 2025.

Kungfu-opettajansa, herra Hanin, sekä legendaarisen Daniel LaRusson viisauksien ohjaamana Li yhdistelee molempien ainutlaatuisia tyylejä valmistautuakseen eeppiseen kamppailumittelöön. Amerikkalainen toimintadraama vuodelta 2025.

programme.desc: Huumorintajuinen komedia, jonka pääosissa näyttelevät Martin Freeman, Josh Hutcherson ja Malin Åkerman. Kun tapahtuma peruutetaan varausvirheen vuoksi, nelikko tarttuu tilaisuuteen ideoida jatko-osaa ja vetäytyy elokuvan alkuperäisille kuvauspaikoille hakemaan inspiraatiota. Pian leirielämän kommellukset, romanttiset jännitteet ja karut totuudet ajavat heidän viikonloppunsa kaaokseen. Komedia vuodelta 2026.

programme.desc: Jotkut ovet vievät menneeseen. Toiset johdattavat tulevaisuuteen. Ja jotkut ovet muuttavat aivan kaiken. Sarah (Margot Robbie) ja David (Colin Farrell) ovat kaksi sinkkua, jotka tapaavat yhteisten ystäviensä häissä ja päätyvät pian vaikuttavallematkalle. Hauskalla ja fantastisella seikkailulla kumpikin heistä saa elää uudestaan menneisyytensä tärkeitä hetkiä ja kenties muuttaa tulevaisuuttaan. Draama vuodelta 2025.

programme.title: The Choral
programme.desc: Ensimmäisen maailmansodan riehuessa pienessä englantilaisessa kaupungissa kuoroyhdistys on menettänyt suurimman osan miehistään armeijalle. Kuoron hallitus päättää jatkaa uusilla jäsenillä. He palkkaavat uuden kuoronjohtajan, tohtori Henry Guthrien, joka on äskettäin palannut Saksasta. Kun kutsuntakirjeet saapuvat, yhteisö huomaa, että paras vastaus sotaan on tehdä musiikkia yhdessä. Brittiläinen sotaelokuva vuodelta 2025.

programme.title: The American Society of Magical Negroes
programme.desc: Maagisten mustien amerikkalainen seura on satiirinen komedia nuoresta miehestä nimeltä Aren, joka värvätään salaseuraan. Seuran jäsenet omistavat elämänsä valkoisten elämän helpottamiselle. Satiirinen komediaelokuva vuodelta 2024.

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: BETTER MAN kertoo Robbie Williamsin tarinan lapsuudesta Take That-tähteyteen ja ennätyksiä rikkovaksi sooloartistiksi. Michael Graceyn (The Greatest Showman) ohjaama elokuva näyttää nousun, romahduksen ja paluun Robbien näkökulmasta, vangiten hänen huumorinsa ja periksiantamattomuutensa. Elokuva käsittelee myös tähtitaivaan tuomia haasteita. Elämäkerrallinen musiikkielokuva vuodelta 2024.

programme.title: Code 3
programme.desc: Elokuvassa seurataan kahden ylityöllistetyn, alipalkatun ja lähes loppuun palaneen ensihoitajan arkea. Toinen ensihoitaja (Rainn Wilson) on niin uupunut työssään, että hän pakottaa itsensä irtisanoutumaan, mutta hänen on lähdettävä vielä viimeiselle, 24 tuntia kestävälle työvuorolle kouluttamaan sijaistaan. Kaikki, mitä ensihoitajan työssä voi tapahtua, tapahtuukin sitten tänä viimeisenä ja riemastuttavana työpäivänä. Amerikkalainen komedia vuodelta 2025.

programme.title: Mother Mary
programme.desc: Maailmanlaajuinen pop-ikoni Mother Mary (Anne Hathaway) on rakentanut uransa huipulla elämää suuremman imagon - mutta kun julkisuuden taakka alkaa murskata hänen sisimpänsä, hän päättää riisua kaiken pois ja kohdata menneisyytensä. Epätoivoisessa hetkessä hän hakeutuu ainoan ihmisen luo, johon hän voi vielä luottaa: visionäärisen muotisuunnittelijan Sam Anselmin (Michaela Coel), vanhan ystävän, jonka hän on vuosia sitten hylännyt. Kun Mary yllättäen ilmestyy Samin syrjäiselle maaseutukartanolle pyytämään pukua elämänsä viimeiseen esitykseen, käynnistyy intensiivinen ja hallusinoiva yö täynnä muistoja, yhteenottoja ja yhteisiä oivalluksia. Mother Mary on säkenöivä draama, joka tutkii identiteettiä, luomisen tuskaa ja ystävyyttä, joka kestää ajan, egojen ja unelmien hauraan loiston. Psykologinen jännityselokuva vuodelta 2026.

programme.title: Meet The Spartans
programme.desc: A spoof of 300 (2006) and many other movies, TV series/shows/commercials, video games and celebrities. King Leonidas of Sparta and his army of 12 go to war against Xerxes of Persia to fight to the death for Sparta's freedom. Contains mild sexual references and language.

programme.title: How to Find Forever
programme.desc: English teacher Penelope Campbell loves her annual summer vacations visiting her Grandma Dot, despite Dot’s constant attempts to set her up with every single man in town. This year, she bumps into Jason Humphrey, none other than her childhood sweetheart, who is still as handsome and charming as ever. It’s a little awkward at first but the conversation soon turns to Jason’s own Grandma Sophie, who keeps doing the same to him! In order to evade the efforts of their matchmaking grandmothers, they make a pact pretending to date each other, but will the old sparks return?

programme.title: Love and Where to Find It
programme.desc: Two local coffee shop business owners despise each other in real life, but fall in love while unknowingly sending each other messages via a dating app on their friends’ behalf.

programme.title: A Picture Perfect Wedding
programme.desc: Wedding photographer Lindsey gets her big opportunity when a New York mogul’s son, Josh, asks her to shoot his sister’s wedding. Sparks fly as Josh and Lindsey prepare for ceremony, and the pair begin to fall for each other. But as the big day arrives and the project finishes, do they go back their old, separate lives or will they follow their hearts?

programme.title: The Princess and the Bodyguard
programme.desc: On her 35th birthday, Lexi discovers that she will suddenly have to give up her normal life in New York and become who she always secretly was… a royal Princess. She has two weeks to come to terms with this, reveal her true identity to her best friend, and find a suitable date for the royal gala, where she will be introduced to the world. All under the watchful eye of her handsome but infuriating bodyguard, Noah.

programme.title: Made for You with Love
programme.desc: The owner of a second hand wedding dress business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she’s afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: When workaholic Jillian gets a note that her long-lost, wealthy uncle has passed away, she finds he’s left her his beautiful mountainside cabin – and a family she never knew existed! Jillian’s plan is to sell it as soon as possible and move on, but when she meets handsome caretaker Liam, he makes her an offer she can’t refuse.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: En besetning av miniatyraliens styr et romskip som har menneskelig form. Mens de prøver å redde planeten sin, møter aliens et nytt problem, da skipet blir forelsket i en jordisk kvinne.

programme.title: The Baby Proposal
programme.desc: Layla Bennett has it all figured out, her own place, a thriving career and a loving fiancé. She co-hosts morning show Wake Up Chicago! Alongside her charming but sometimes irritating colleague Derek Dray. They have different working styles. She likes to be spontaneous and improvise on air, while he’s more of a stick to the script guy. When they’re given the bombshell of caring for a baby together, it’s their worst nightmare…But as they juggle night feeds and nap times with their hectic lives, they can’t deny the growing chemistry. Is this unexpected arrival all they needed to realise they were meant to be?

programme.title: A Slice of Romance
programme.desc: When unlucky in love PR Executive Mikayla meets coffee shop owner and aspiring pastry chef Austin, the pair strike a deal: she'll taste his desserts if he gives her dating advice. Little did they know sparks would fly between them.

programme.title: The Dating List
programme.desc: Career driven Abby agrees to help her busy boss find the man of her dreams, but she encounters a dilemma when she starts falling for the same man her boss approves of dating.

programme.title: A Vineyard Romance
programme.desc: When Seattle magazine writer Samantha Hart is sent home to write an article about the wedding destination of Hawthorne Vineyards, she discovers the ex who broke her heart not only runs the vineyard, but he's about to get married there.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: Theresa, a young woman, takes her boyfriend, Simon, home to introduce him to her parents and share the surprise of their engagement. There's another twist: Simon is white.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Spoof of romantic comedies which focuses on a woman, her crush, her parents, and her father. Contains sex reference and strong language.

programme.title: Eat, Drink and Be Married
programme.desc: Just three days out from their wedding day, Jess and Max are ready to call it quits from the out-of-control planning. They visit Billie, the owner of a wedding donation company, specializing in donating leftover wedding elements to those in need. However Max’s brother Charlie will stop at nothing to keep them together, he enlists the help of Billie to ensure this meant-to-be couple gets hitched once and for all.

programme.title: Eat, Drink and Be Married
programme.desc: Just three days out from their wedding day, Jess and Max are ready to call it quits from the out-of-control planning. They visit Billie, the owner of a wedding donation company, specializing in donating leftover wedding elements to those in need. However Max’s brother Charlie will stop at nothing to keep them together, he enlists the help of Billie to ensure this meant-to-be couple gets hitched once and for all.

programme.title: Love on Harbor Island
programme.desc: Interior designer Lily returns home to help her Aunt Maggie run her marina-side bed and breakfast when she meets Marcus, a handsome seaplane pilot whose work delivering rescue dogs helps Lily discover that home really is where the heart is

programme.title: The Beauty of Love
programme.desc: Emma has built a successful lifestyle website that she puts her heart and soul into called Classically Emma. But when her numbers start trending down, she thinks she might've found her fix in a partnership with ambitious Jill.

programme.title: A Country Romance
programme.desc: When Sarah Kress learns her family’s vineyard is up for sale, she leaves her busy urban life and visits her hometown to help with the sale and have her last harvest. With the help of handsome neighbor Gabe, huge challenge becomes fun as she and Gabe fall in love. But when the job is done, Sarah must decide whether to return to her fast-paced life or follow her heart.

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: When Rose, a passionate fashion stylist in her 30’s living in New York, inherits her grandmother’s vintage dress shop, she returns to her small hometown to take care of the store. As she’s contemplating closing the store for good, she runs into her charming high school crush, Cole Murphy, who convinces her to restore the store and help people in need that can’t afford new clothes. After hesitantly agreeing, the two friends reminisce about their old feelings, and realize that the store is not the only that deserves a second chance, but so does their love.

programme.title: Love is a Piece of Cake
programme.desc: Jessie Dale is a third generation baker who loves her cake shop more than anything in the world. When developers threaten to buy her building and force her out, she must do all she can to save her bakery, all while juggling a blossoming romance with her client's brother.

programme.title: Blueprint to the Heart
programme.desc: A talented host and designer of a high-end renovation television show is forced to change her show format to include life makeovers as well after her ratings dip. However, when she tries to upscale the handsome and down-to-Earth subject of her first episode, she must choose between chasing ratings or following her heart.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: An urbane fox cannot resist returning to his farm raiding ways and then must help his community survive the farmers' retaliation.

programme.title: Cooking with Love
programme.desc: Hardworking & optimistic television producer, Kelly, doesn’t have time for love. Along with her mentor Amanda, Kelly dives into another season of the Little Gourmet, a kids cooking show, when hot-headed Chef Stephen is dropped into Kelly’s life as a last minute replacement host. As the two struggle to make peace and a successful show, they realize they have a lot more in common than they thought – a love of food, the kids they encounter & each other.

programme.title: Planning on Forever
programme.desc: Emma is an events planner who doesn't have time for love, until her sister reveals that her wedding is in six weeks. Emma agrees to step in and plan it herself with the help of Liam, who Emma had a disastrous blind date with years ago.

programme.title: Her Son's Secret
programme.desc: Inspired by true events. Sarah has never given up. Having lost her son Matt 13 years ago – presumed drowned and the body never recovered — she still keeps her hopes up. One day, Matt shows up at Sarah’s door. A DNA test confirms his identity, but Matt remembers little of his family. Suspicions grow when Matt’s brother is injured in a car accident like the one that killed his father. Is Matt an impostor? And if he’s real, does he want a loving home or revenge?

programme.title: Nanny's Killer Scandal
programme.desc: With a degree from Dartmouth, Jamie Kassman is ready to take on the real world! Only, she can’t find anyone who will hire her without business experience. Temporarily she accepts a job as a nanny for none other than her idol, the charismatic multimillionaire Walter Page. Things start off great and Warren even mentors her. But when he tries to kiss her and she rejects his advances, his intentions quickly go from inappropriate to deadly…

programme.title: Crazy, Rich and Deadly
programme.desc: When Brandi arrives at her boyfriend Aaron’s family estate, she is surprised to discover that his father is one of the richest men in the country. But as Brandi falls deeper in love, she begins to suspect that Aaron’s family harbors a deadly secret.

programme.title: Secrets of a Gold Digger Killer
programme.desc: The chilling true story that inspired the novel, The Fortune Hunter, by the New York Times best selling author, Suzy Spencer. When Celeste Beard’s multimillionaire husband was killed by her delusional and disturbed friend Tracey, Celeste was certain she would never be blamed. But when Celeste’s twin daughters discovered that their mother had planned the murder and convinced Tracey to pull the trigger, they work to turn the tables and bring her to justice.

programme.title: A Deadly Abduction
programme.desc: Eve’s restaurant is gaining popularity online thanks to Grace, her social media savvy daughter; yet, when Grace mysteriously disappears, Eve is in danger as she finds the key to Grace’s disappearance in her daughter’s private Instagram account.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In America
programme.desc: The epic crime drama directed by Sergio Leone that chronicles decades of friendship, betrayal, and ambition in New York’s underworld. Spanning from the early 1900s to the 1960s, the film follows David “Noodles” Aaronson, played by Robert De Niro, and his rise from a small-time street kid to a powerful gangster. Told through a haunting, non-linear narrative, the story explores loyalty, lost love, and the heavy cost of power. With its sweeping cinematography and unforgettable score by Ennio Morricone, the film stands as a melancholic, operatic reflection on memory and regret.
